book.title: Dragons of Eden: Speculations on the Evolution of Human Intelligence
book.description: Dr Carl Sagan takes us on a great reading adventure, offering his vivid and startling insights into the brains of humans & beasts, the origin of human intelligence, the function of our most haunting legends and their amazing links to recent discoveries.
